questions.stem: A spinner has sections coloured red, blue, green, and yellow. $P(\text{red}) = 0.2$, $P(\text{blue}) = 0.35$, $P(\text{green}) = 0.15$. What is $P(\text{yellow})$?
questions.explanation: The outcomes are mutually exclusive and exhaustive, so their probabilities sum to $1$. $P(\text{yellow}) = 1 - 0.2 - 0.35 - 0.15 = 0.3$.

questions.stem: Which pair of events is NOT mutually exclusive when drawing a single card from a standard deck?

options.text: Drawing a king and drawing a queen
Drawing a heart and drawing a diamond
Drawing a red card and drawing a king

questions.explanation: A card can be both red and a king (e.g. king of hearts, king of diamonds). These events can happen simultaneously, so they are not mutually exclusive.
